_note: Every fixed sentence the overlay shows. tests/test_verifier.py runs each through the Verifier, with sample values for the placeholders.
disclaimer: Synthetic match. The battery describes the running: what it would leave a typical professional, never how tired this player is.
battery: {name} has done running that would leave a typical professional at about {pct}% of their short-term reserve.
band: Our estimate, with a 10–90% band of {lo}–{hi}% of a typical professional's reserve, because his own fitness is unknown.
lowChance: A typical professional would be in the red after running like this {chance} of the time, by our calibrated estimate.
legendBattery: Battery: what this running would leave a typical professional (5 levels)
redZone: {name} is in a red-zone spell: high-speed running at his peak.
postPeak: {name} is catching breath after a red-zone spell.
offPitch: {name} is not on the pitch at this point.
topSpeed: {name}'s fastest second so far: {v} m/s ({kmh} km/h).
teamChart: Tug of war: each team's high-speed running per ball-in-play minute, in 5-min blocks
blocked: Lines the Verifier blocked, with the rule they broke; they never reach the screen.
